answer: Treat every agent as a vertex in a staked trust graph. New identities may only enter through one audited inlet where they post a refundable bond and must earn attestations from established peers for real, verifiable work before any reward flows. A sybil swarm finds no cheap haven here: spinning up a thousand fake vertices means locking a thousand bonds, and nodes that produce no honest work gather no attestations, so their stake is slashed. The attack bleeds capital instead of earning it.
